baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain أَرْسَلْنَا / رَسُول / بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ / لِيُبَيِّنَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispatched carrier bears a saying through the language already shared by his community, so clarification is a sender-carrier-medium-audience relay rather than an abstract transfer of information.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message image supplies both the carrier and the saying carried through the relay.
Language, speech, news, and message make the people's tongue the relay's shared medium.
The people or community image fixes the audience as the messenger's own social body.
Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the relay's purpose: making the carried meaning accessible.

changed_reading.before: A messenger merely speaks the audience's native language.
changed_reading.after: The message is fitted to an existing communal channel so that sender, carrier, speech, and audience form one intelligible relay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause لِيُبَيِّنَ is immediately followed by the opposed verbs يُضِلُّ and يَهْدِي.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bayān can separate as well as reveal. The clarified field exposes a boundary on which one trajectory veers or disappears while the other is gently directed toward a way.

activation_trace.role: Separation after connection supplies the differentiating edge within clarification.
Appearance and disclosure make that differentiating edge visible.
Disappearance and hiddenness supply one possible trajectory after the field is disclosed.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the opposed directed trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Clarification is neutral explanation followed by unrelated outcomes.
changed_reading.after: Clarification opens a visible differentiating field in which hidden loss and directed movement become opposed trajectories.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact repetition مَن يَشَاءُ frames both outcomes, and the ayah closes with ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired outcomes remain under one will and are enclosed by prevailing power plus restraint, judgment, and right knowledge. The closure marks governance rather than a failure of the messenger's language.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to an effected thing supplies the symmetric control repeated over both outcomes.
Prevailing force supplies the capacity by which neither outcome escapes divine governance.
Restraint and prevention for repair keep power from reading as undirected force.
Knowledge that reaches the right supplies the discriminating intelligence of the governance.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and misguidance are signs that communication either succeeds or fails.
changed_reading.after: Both outcomes lie inside a powerful but restrained and knowing governance, so linguistic clarity is not identical with compelled uptake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening purpose chain turns clarification into passage: what is sent enables an emergence from concealment and darkness into illumination and a straight route, under permission.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure by speech or sign anchors the changed mechanism in the focus purpose clause.
Bringing something out of concealment turns verbal disclosure into an enacted extraction.
Light and illumination supply the visible destination of that extraction.
Permission makes the transition authorized rather than an autonomous effect of the speaker.
The straight road converts illumination into a traversable direction.

structural_cues: 14:1 places the sent book, خروج, darkness-to-light motion, permission, and path in one purpose chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, extraction, illumination, permission, and road; I infer that the focus clarification activates a state transition, while the live alternative is that 14:1 describes the book's broader mission without specifying every messenger's speech event.

changed_reading.before: The messenger explains propositions in familiar words.
changed_reading.after: Familiar speech is an authorized extraction medium that moves hearers from a hidden state into visible, traversable direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shared language channel can be actively reversed. Hearers obstruct the road, seek its crookedness, and answer manifest proofs by returning and speaking rejection through their own mouths; clarity therefore exposes refusal without coercing assent.

activation_trace.role: Language and speech anchor the mechanism in the focus ayah's shared communicative channel.
Turning away and diverting supply active obstruction rather than passive incomprehension.
Semantic deviation from straightness supplies deliberate distortion of the disclosed way.
Manifest signs make the object of rejection visible rather than obscure.
Non-acceptance and rejection supply the counter-motion applied to the manifest signs.
Opening the mouth in speech locates rejection inside the same bodily channel as communicative clarity.
Interpenetrating alternatives that prevent certainty supply the hearers' declared unsettled state.

structural_cues: 14:3 joins obstruction, path, sought crookedness, and distant error.
14:9 places messengers and manifest signs before a mouth-centered gesture and an explicit declaration of disbelief and doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obstruction, semantic crookedness, manifest proof, rejection, mouths, and doubt; I infer a reversal of the communicative channel, while the mouth gesture may alternatively accompany rejection without causing it.

changed_reading.before: Using the people's language should remove the decisive obstacle to belief.
changed_reading.after: Shared language makes refusal answerable and visible, but the same channel can carry deliberate distortion, rejection, and doubt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's relation to 'his people' is not guaranteed harmony. The community can threaten to expel its own messenger or force him back into its followed creed, so local speech places revelation inside a struggle over membership and conformity.

activation_trace.role: The community and kin-group image anchors the belonging that becomes contested.
Shared language places the conflict within, rather than outside, the community's communicative world.
The messengers as carriers of a saying identify the members targeted by the ultimatum.
Passage to the outside supplies threatened removal from the people's land.
Return after departure supplies the demanded reversal back into communal conformity.
A followed creed supplies the social form into which the messengers are ordered to return.

structural_cues: 14:13 gives the disbelieving people a two-part ultimatum to their messengers: leave our land or return to our creed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared peoplehood, expulsion, return, and creed; I infer that local-language mission intensifies an internal belonging dispute, while the live alternative is that the ultimatum is political and confessional without a special linguistic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: 'His people' simply identifies the audience best equipped to understand him.
changed_reading.after: 'His people' names an intimate but contested public whose shared speech makes disagreement an internal struggle over land, loyalty, and creed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ash-and-wind comparison materializes misguidance as loss of retained result. Acquired work becomes residue, violent air scatters it, and its owners cannot recover control over any of it; distant error is dispersal and dispossession as well as a wrong route.

activation_trace.role: Loss of a thing anchors the materialized reading in the focus verb of misguidance.
Ash left by burning supplies a fragile residue for the actors' works.
Wind and moving air supply the carrier that removes the residue.
A violent wind that lightens and scatters things supplies the destructive transport.
Effective capacity and possession are explicitly absent, completing the loss of control.
Seeking and obtaining gain identify what the actors expected their works to retain.
The general knowable thing makes the dispossession exhaustive: not one recoverable item remains.
The explicit label of distant loss binds the material sequence back to the focus verb.

structural_cues: 14:18 moves from works, to ash, to storm wind, to inability over anything acquired, and then names the whole sequence distant ضلال.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material sequence and its final label; I infer that dispersion explains the label's loss branch, while the alternative is that the comparison concerns worthlessness or incapacity without defining misguidance itself.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance is principally departure from a correct route.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance can also be the dispersal of accumulated action until its owner cannot locate, retain, or command any result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's repeated will becomes concrete in a remove-and-replace operation: God can take the present hearers away and bring a newly originated creation, and that replacement is not difficult for Him.

activation_trace.role: Will related to effected things anchors the context's concrete operation in the focus repetition.
The conditional act of willing initiates the context's remove-and-replace sequence.
Going away supplies removal of the current human recipients.
Origination and bringing into being supply both the cosmic frame and the replacement creation.
New occurrence after a break gives the replacement its discontinuous novelty.
The negated image of difficulty states that no hard resistance blocks the operation.

structural_cues: 14:19 makes يَشَأْ govern removal and the arrival of a new creation; 14:20 immediately denies that this is difficult for God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies willing, removal, new origination, and negated difficulty; I infer that the focus will is effectual and recreative, while the alternative is that the sequence demonstrates general power without specifying how individual guidance outcomes occur.

changed_reading.before: The repeated 'whom He wills' sounds like an unexplained selection formula.
changed_reading.after: Will is an effective capacity to remove an existing configuration and originate another, with no difficulty constraining the change.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates ultimate governance from proximate persuasion. Messenger selection is bestowed by will, compelling proof or force remains permission-bound, social leaders imagine relaying guidance, and the counter-caller finally admits that he only called and hearers answered without coercive authority.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction anchors the layered account in the focus act of guidance.
Release without exchange supplies the bestowed character of messenger selection.
Will attached to the bestowed act links selection back to the focus formula.
Overwhelming proof names what the messengers cannot independently produce.
Permission limits the production of compelling proof to divine authorization.
The repeated guidance verbs expose a claimed social relay from leaders to followers.
Loyal succession supplies the follower relation through which guidance was expected to pass.
The denied image of coercive force removes compulsion from the counter-caller's proximate action.
Calling and inclining by speech supply the counter-message's actual intervention.
Answering speech supplies the hearers' uptake of that call.
The self as the thing itself receives blame, locating responsibility at the responding subject.

structural_cues: 14:11 joins divine bestowal, will, lack of independently produced سلطان, and permission.
14:21-22 moves from followers blaming leaders to an explicit no-authority, call-response, blame-yourselves account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ultimate will, permission-bound proof, social following, denied coercion, call, response, and self-blame; I infer layered causation, while the live alternative is that the focus's divine causation and 14:22's human response remain parallel claims whose precise relation is intentionally unspecified.

changed_reading.before: God directly imposes either guidance or misguidance on isolated recipients.
changed_reading.after: Ultimate divine governance coexists with noncoercive speech, social relays, answering subjects, and proximate responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The locally intelligible message becomes a word that can take root and remain stable or be torn out and lack settlement. The later clause that God stabilizes by the stable saying, misguides, and does what He wills converts the focus pair into a stability-versus-uprooting mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Language, word, and message anchor the tree mechanism in the focus medium.
Meaning disclosed by speech anchors the word's intelligible entry into hearers.
Intelligible utterance connecting speakers supplies the message-object compared to a tree.
Rootedness and firmness supply deep attachment for the good word.
Continuance and stability supply persistence after the word is received.
Being pulled out wholly from the root supplies the bad word's loss of attachment.
Stability and settlement are explicitly absent from the uprooted configuration.
Strengthening and making firm apply the tree's stability mechanics to believers and the stable saying.
Spoken saying identifies the stabilizing object as communicative rather than merely botanical.
Loss supplies the opposed outcome after the stability imagery.
Divine willing closes the stability-and-loss pair with the same governing formula as the focus.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 contrasts a good word with fixed root and a bad word uprooted without settlement.
14:27 immediately repeats stability, saying, divine misguidance, and divine will.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two word-tree configurations and then repeats the focus's misguidance and will; I infer that the simile's stability mechanics illuminate the focus pair, while the alternative is that the tree comparison remains an ethical illustration rather than a mechanism for the focus verbs.

changed_reading.before: The people's tongue is a temporary vehicle for an explanatory speech.
changed_reading.after: The intelligible speech is planted as a word whose reception becomes durable rootedness or uprooted loss of settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same causative misguidance root receives proximate agents elsewhere: people install rival counterparts in order to divert from the path, and idols mislead many. The focus's divine agency therefore coexists with constructed rivals, followership, and creaturely diversion.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance anchors the distributed-agent problem in the focus's divine causative verb.
Making something assume a state supplies the human installation of rival agents.
A contrary counterpart supplies the rival object around which diversion is organized.
The causative departure from guidance is explicitly assigned to the rival-making project.
A traversed extended road supplies the route from which people are diverted.
The idols' causative misguidance supplies a second proximate agent using the focus root.
Following behind supplies the human uptake that distinguishes Abraham's followers from those diverted.

structural_cues: 14:30 assigns a purpose of misguiding from God's path to people who make rivals.
14:36 grammatically presents the idols as having misled many and then distinguishes whoever follows Abraham.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated causative ضلل with divine, human, and idol agents plus following; I infer nested or distributed agency, while the live alternative is that ultimate judgment and proximate temptation are simply juxtaposed without defining their causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Only one immediately acting agent stands behind the focus's guidance divide.
changed_reading.after: The surah preserves divine ultimacy while also naming installed rivals, social actors, and following as proximate mechanisms of diversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final titles unfold as a timed legal sequence. Delay is not heedlessness; warning and an interval for response precede retrospective clarification through inhabited precedents and examples, after which prevailing strength secures the promise to the messengers and punishment follows denial.

activation_trace.role: Restraint for repair anchors the interval before enforcement in the focus title.
Judgment between people supplies the adjudicative destination of the interval.
The explicitly denied lapse of awareness prevents delay from being read as lost oversight.
Deferral to a later time supplies deliberate temporal spacing before judgment.
Warning that awakens caution fills the interval with advance notice.
The requested chance to answer the call exposes response as the opportunity the delayed audience lost.
What became apparent through prior dwellings extends clarification beyond the messenger's immediate speech.
The example as admonitory sign supplies an additional evidentiary medium before enforcement.
A promise that fails at its appointed time is explicitly denied of God.
A spoken promise opening expectation supplies the commitment that divine power secures.
The messengers and their carried message are the beneficiaries of the secured promise.
Prevailing force supplies enforcement against every counter-project.
Punishment after denial supplies the terminal consequence of adjudication.

structural_cues: 14:42 denies heedlessness and names deferral; 14:44 recalls warning and a refused response interval.
14:45 says the outcome became clear through dwellings and examples; 14:47 denies broken promise and repeats رسول and عزيز before punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate delay, warning, requested response, retrospective clarification, examples, promise, messengers, prevailing force, and punishment; I infer a staged adjudication governed by حكمة and عزة, while the alternative is that these are adjacent assurances rather than one procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: Al-Aziz and al-Hakim are static assurances appended to the guidance divide.
changed_reading.after: The titles govern a timed process: restraint leaves an evidenced response interval, judgment closes it, and prevailing power enforces the messenger-facing promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's final self-description completes the relay begun in the focus ayah. Communication reaches people, awakens caution, produces recognition, and is retained in memory; local language is the entry condition for a public chain whose endpoint is durable knowing and recollection.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message anchor the closure's reaching process in the focus relay.
Using a tongue to deliver a message supplies the fitted means by which the relay reaches its public.
Disclosure of meaning by speech supplies the intelligible middle stage of the relay.
Delivering a message to its destination names the surah as the completed relay.
The human public supplies the destination beyond the focus messenger's immediate community.
Warning that wakes caution supplies the first stated effect of arrival.
Disclosure to the knower supplies recognition as the next effect.
Bringing something back after forgetfulness supplies durable recollection as the relay's recurring endpoint.

structural_cues: 14:52 calls the discourse بلاغ للناس and coordinates warning, knowing, and remembering as its purposes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, a human public, warning, knowing, and remembering; I infer a sequential communication cycle that completes the focus relay, while the alternative is that the coordinated purposes are parallel rather than temporally ordered.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a one-time explanation from one messenger to his people.
changed_reading.after: The fitted local utterance initiates a relay that reaches a wider public and recurs as warning, recognition, and remembered knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قَوْم in the focus ordinarily names the people, while support, standing, and resurrection are latent branches rather than replacements for that noun. It remains anchored in the focus root and in later ق و م occurrences that establish prayer and stand for account. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary root resonance, never translate قَوْم as 'support system.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus phrase لِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ combines language with the ق و م root.

activation_trace.role: Language and speech supply what is fitted to the community's mode of standing.
Support, structure, and what sustains life supply the exploratory communal infrastructure resonance.
Rising with resolve toward an act makes established prayer one practice by which the addressed community stands.
The prayer for one who rises to the act repeats communal standing across generations.
Rising for the final hour extends the standing resonance from communal practice to account.

changed_reading.before: The people's tongue means only their shared vocabulary.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root resonance, the tongue is fitted to what makes a community stand, from enacted worship to its eventual standing for account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping for the focus root ه د ي, so it is form-distant from the ordinary guidance branch. It remains valid as a packet-supplied mapped-root activation and is reinforced by the later warning that awakens caution. Downstream prose must label it an exploratory secondary resonance, not a lexical gloss of يَهْدِي.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word يَهْدِي has a packet-supplied secondary mapped inventory at root_001580.

activation_trace.role: Threat and warning supply the form-distant possibility that caution-awakening pressure participates in direction.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution provides a context-local mechanism for the secondary resonance.
Prevailing force contains the warning within the focus closure's power rather than treating it as stray rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: Guidance operates only as gentle indication toward a route.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, direction may also include a warning pressure that awakens caution, while gentle guidance remains the primary reading.

strongest_changes: Local-language clarification became an authorized passage from concealment into visible direction, not mere translation.
Shared speech was shown to permit active rejection without coercion, while ultimate divine governance coexists with social calls and answering subjects.
Misguidance acquired material mechanisms of dispersion, dispossession, uprooting, and loss of settlement.
Repeated divine will became recreative removal and replacement, and the closing titles unfolded as timed restraint, judgment, and promise enforcement.
The final بلاغ sequence extended one messenger's explanation into public warning, recognition, and durable recollection.
summary.what_was_special: The surah repeatedly reintroduced the focus roots inside concrete mechanisms: mouths reject manifest signs, ash loses all recoverable gain, words root or are uprooted, later dwellings make outcomes apparent, and the final message reaches a public. These recurrences kept several readings live without collapsing divine agency, communicative process, and human response into one level.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not resolve the exact causal relation between divine misguidance and the proximate diversion attributed to callers, leaders, people, and idols.
The قَوْم / قيام model may be a productive root resonance rather than a functional sense of the focus noun.
The ه د د warning activation is explicitly packet-supplied but form-distant and should remain exploratory.
